name: Hoi An Moon Premium Boutique Hotel and Spa
detail: I was very satisfied. The room was spacious, clean, and the interior was lovely. Being a new hotel, the linens were very comfortable. There was also no strong smell often found in hotels in Vietnam, making it a very nice hotel. All the staff spoke English very well. In contrast to the elegant interior characteristic of Hoi An, the warm hospitality felt more like coming to a homestay than a luxury hotel. The suggestions for my itinerary and the hotel services were provided without any uncomfortable feeling; this is not something that can be mastered overnight. The warm service and consideration, while not intrusive, were commendable (since I work in the service industry myself). The breakfast was primarily made up of traditional Central Vietnamese dishes, all of which were delicious. The hotel’s spa was a bit cold for me, but the service itself was good. The only issue I had was with the bathtub; it was hard to understand how to use the hot water, which resulted in a hot bath (this was due to my inattention and not the hotel's fault). Overall, all aspects of the QSCA were high quality, making it a very good hotel. My mother and friend who accompanied me were also very satisfied, and considering the price was relatively low (it was packaged with the flight), I would like to stay longer next time. It was truly a great hotel. Thank you for the wonderful experience.

name: Little Oasis . An Eco Friendly Hotel & Spa
detail: This is a hidden luxury hotel in Hoi An, perfect for relaxing slowly. The room we stayed in had a balcony with river and city views, and it was equipped with a bathtub. It's a room that would be classified as a suite in other hotels. The cleanliness was impeccable, and everything was well-maintained. One minor concern was that the walls seemed thin, as we could hear the TV and conversations from the neighboring room. There were also interferences with the TV operation where it would suddenly turn off, the volume would change to very loud, or channels would switch. The hospitality from the staff was exceptional. The breakfast buffet offered a wonderful view, with home-grown vegetable gardens and water buffaloes nearby. The variety of food was abundant and delicious. We stayed for four nights, and every day, the staff member Lisa engaged with us, offering travel advice and checking on the weather with great care. It’s very convenient to call a car to reach the old town, so the location is not an issue at all. If you're looking to escape the hustle and bustle of the city and relax both body and mind, this is the perfect place. I will definitely stay here again when I come to Hoi An. Thank you very much!

name: Grand Sunrise Palace Hoi An
detail: The inside of the accommodation is large for a hotel. There are plenty of lights everywhere, and the bathroom is spacious (partially transparent), and any inquiries or calls are responded to quickly and resolved. We were very satisfied with the meals and massages. Not only was the breakfast good, but the dinner options (pizza, sandwiches, noodles) were much better in terms of price and taste compared to eating outside in Hoi An. The hotel's shuttle also goes to the Old Town and An Dong Beach, and the massages are good too~ The downside is that there is no landscaping, and around 5 a.m., a rooster crows for about 20 minutes, waking us up.

name: La Siesta Hoi An Resort & Spa
detail: We celebrated our 10th wedding anniversary with a family stay and it was truly a satisfying time. The resort was quiet and blended well with nature, making it perfect for relaxation. The room was spacious and clean, allowing us to rest comfortably. The staff members were always friendly and greeted us with smiles, which made us feel good throughout our stay. The breakfast had a variety of options and the food was delicious. The pool was also well-maintained, and we had a great time with our child. It was conveniently close to the Old Town, and there was a shuttle bus, making sightseeing easy. Thanks to this, our family was able to create happy memories, and the 10th anniversary trip became even more meaningful. If we visit Hoi An again, I will likely choose La Siesta Hoi An Resort & Spa once more. I confidently recommend it for both family trips and couple getaways!

name: The Signature Hoi An
detail: This was the first hotel we stayed at in Vietnam, and we were impressed by the high level of hospitality. Staff from all positions were very kind and friendly. The room was spacious and decorated in a style that perfectly suits the city of Hoi An. It was conveniently located within walking distance of the old town and night market. We requested a pickup from Da Nang airport, and they offered a slightly discounted rate for the return trip, with quick message exchanges that gave us peace of mind. The quality of the breakfast was very high, and the pho soup was incredibly delicious. The presentation of brewing Vietnamese coffee right next to the table was wonderful as well. Upon check-in, we received a 30-minute free massage voucher and a snack service voucher for the restaurant. We used the snack service for lunch the next day, and it was so substantial that we couldn't believe it was free! This is a truly wonderful hotel, and if we ever go back to Hoi An, we will undoubtedly choose this hotel again. I highly recommend it to everyone.

name: Reu Boutique Hotel
detail: It was my first stay at a boutique hotel, and I loved it; it's among the best hotels I've ever stayed at! First of all, the location is outstanding. It's situated right in the middle of tranquil rice fields, allowing for a very relaxing experience away from the hustle and bustle of the city center (though it might not be suitable for those wanting to stay right in the middle of town, it's only about a 5-10 minute drive to the old town of Hoi An, so access is not an issue at all). The building, designed by a famous architectural firm in Vietnam, is stylish from every angle. The staff were all very kind and greeted us with bright smiles, making our stay comfortable from start to finish. The spacious pool and delicious breakfast, along with the quality of service, provide excellent value for money. When I come to Hoi An again, I definitely want to stay here, and I will certainly return!

name: Southern Hotel
detail: My family and I had the chance to experience Raon Palm Villa - it was truly wonderful: it gives you a sense of peace with lots of greenery, a clean swimming pool that my kids really enjoyed. The room is spacious, clean, and airy. The staff is very friendly and professional. Thank you, Raon Team, for giving me such an interesting vacation!

name: HOTEL ROYAL HOI AN, The Legacy by the River
detail: The room and hotel facilities were well-maintained, very clean, and I was able to spend my time there comfortably. The front staff was very helpful as I couldn't speak English; they translated information about my stay using a computer screen. The airport transfer service was also very helpful. There were many options for breakfast, and everything was very delicious. The hotel's location was slightly away from the old town, making it quiet at night. The exterior view of the hotel from the riverside was beautiful both during the day and at night. It was a wonderful hotel.

detail: Great place with sanitairy facilities outside the rooms which is great! Nice staff and many travelers. Recommended

name: ANNAM Heritage Boutique Hotel & Spa
detail: The location is about a 5-minute walk from the city center, but it is quiet and surrounded by restaurants and supermarkets, making it very convenient. The interior is spacious and has a balcony, but it is not equipped with the latest facilities, such as power outlets and the inability to flush toilet paper. On the other hand, the facilities are well-maintained, the pool and bar are easy to use, and the staff is friendly. It was comfortable.
